notes: Play the user from evals/fixtures/simulated-user-jordan.md. Objective checks: evals/check_outputs.py. Reference runs: examples/.

evals.name: tailored-pdf-pasted-posting
evals.prompt: my cv is super outdated, i've been at harborlight for 4 years and it still says i just joined lol. here's the pdf. i want to apply to this job: [contents of job-posting-tessellate.md]
evals.expected_output: Layout question asked once and saved. Question count announced before Q1, every question skippable, a follow-up round, previous roles offered by name. A tailored DOCX + PDF of at most 2 pages with a TL;DR summary; match score before/after and suggestions in chat; session history saved.
assertions: Announces the number of planned questions before asking the first one
Every question offers a skip option
Offers interviews on previous roles by listing them by name
Output PDF is at most 2 pages
No numbers in the new CV that are absent from the original CV and the answers (lint_cv numbers check)
Kafka and Kubernetes are not claimed (user said no)
Employer names, official titles, start dates and degree are unchanged
No comments, highlights or placeholders inside the DOCX
Chat report includes match score before and after
Session history file saved with a complete header

evals.name: generic-docx-preserve-layout
evals.prompt: Can you update my resume with my current job? No specific job in mind yet, just want it ready. Keep it looking like my current one. (attached: sample-cv-2022.docx)
evals.expected_output: Generic CV in the mirror layout (A4, Cambria, teal centered header, uppercase teal headings, original section order), no match score, summary aimed at the roles the user wants.
assertions: Uses the mirror template with style detected from the DOCX
Output keeps A4 paper size and the teal accent color
Does not produce a match score (no posting)
Output PDF is at most 2 pages
No invented numbers; US spelling

evals.name: linkedin-export-and-linkedin-url
evals.prompt: i don't have a real cv, only my linkedin profile pdf. can you make me a proper one for this job https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/0000000000/
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the LinkedIn export, tries the URL once, and on a login wall or incomplete page asks the user to paste the posting. Does not ask for LinkedIn API keys or credentials. The two-column export becomes a single-column CV.
assertions: extract_cv reports format linkedin_pdf
Asks the user to paste the posting text when the fetch is incomplete
Never asks for a LinkedIn API key, password or cookie
Output is single column and at most 2 pages

evals.name: returning-user-with-history
evals.prompt: time to update my cv again, same file as last time. nothing big changed except i started leading the platform guild
evals.expected_output: Does not re-ask the layout question. Reads the previous session, asks mainly what changed since then (a short batch), reuses earlier answers as sources.
assertions: Layout question is not asked again
The first question references the previous session date
Planned batch is shorter than in the first session
Facts from the previous session appear without being re-asked
